Hi Alex — great to hear you got started, and thanks for the note. A short 15-minute pre-demo compatibility check makes total sense and is exactly what we do to make full demos more productive.

Quick proposal:
- Purpose: confirm network egress, authentication (API key/KMS), expected model family and max sequence length, and KV/prefix-caching behavior.
- Who: me (SDR) + Dylan (solutions engineer) on our side.
- Duration: 15 minutes.

I have an open window today 11:30–12:30 PST and tomorrow 10:00–12:00 PST. If that doesn't work, you can pick a slot here: https://cal.example.com/bc/15min
